capabilities: Log workouts on a monthly calendar with completion checkboxes
Create custom exercises organized by muscle group
Record sets in weight/reps, reps, time/distance, or time formats
Store each workout as a Markdown note in a configurable progress folder
Count completed workouts and sets per month
extras: Listed by manifest as not yet manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; GitHub release install is separate from Community Plugins approval. Mobile layout tested only in a 390 px Chromium viewport, not on physical iOS/Android devices. Bilingual Russian/English interface with English fallback; no network requests or accounts.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track workouts or exercise history, so users must log training manually in freeform notes.

relations.evidence: Также можно установить через BRAT, указав vladtopchu/simple-train-obsidian-plugin.

summary: Workout journal with a monthly calendar for logging exercises, sets, and muscle groups in local Markdown notes.
